firstPlayerRule: After everyone rolls, the player with the red-bordered conveyor belt goes first, then play moves to the left.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Gamewright-hosted rules PDF listed on gamewright.com/rules and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 2: "To start a round, all players pick up all the dice on their conveyor belts and roll them on the table." "EVERYBODY TAKES A TURN The player who has the red-bordered conveyor belt goes first, then play moves to the left until each player has had a turn."
